_README: Hand-curated booth facts that no crawled source publishes - coordinates above all.
Staged through the normal extracted_record -> resolve path under the 'manual'
source (priority_rank 0), so these values win field resolution against every
crawled source and are never overwritten by a later refresh. Applied by
`epcot-fw manual apply`, and automatically at the start of crawl/refresh.
`name` is matched fuzzily against booths for the current festival, exactly the
way a crawled record is, so it does not have to be byte-identical.
location_precision says what the coordinate is worth:
surveyed - a GPS fix taken standing at the booth. Metres.
mapped   - a pin dropped by eye on a real map (docs/map.html), matched
against Disney's festival map or satellite imagery. Better
than an anchor, not as good as a GPS fix.
anchored - the published coordinate of the pavilion the booth is named
after, standing in until someone places or surveys it. 30-50m,
which is enough to place a booth on the right side of World
Showcase and not enough to order two booths near each other.
The anchored entries below come from the Wikipedia/Wikidata coordinates for
each World Showcase pavilion (CC BY-SA). They are a floor, not an answer:
replace one with a mapped or surveyed fix and it wins on recency. Use
docs/map.html at a desk, or docs/survey.html on a phone in the park, to
capture them - both emit entries in this shape.
Everything not named here has no coordinate at all yet, including Refreshment
Outpost, Brew-Wing Lab and every themed kiosk. Nothing publishes those.

booths.name: Tangierine Café: Flavors of the Medina
